en: The image depicts an interior hospital ward with several women, presumably nurses, standing near seated patients. The room is furnished with wicker chairs, tables, potted plants, and a few personal items, suggesting a relatively comfortable hospital environment. The lighting is bright, likely from large windows. There are privacy curtains dividing the space, and a sense of order and cleanliness is evident. The image is in black and white, and appears quite old. There is text at the bottom of the postcard, partially legible.
